```json
      "polarity": "success",
      "covers": "happy"
    },
    {
      "name": "Empty input",
      "given": "args=[], stdin='', stdout='', stderr=''",

    },
    {
      "name": "Non-alphanumeric characters",
      "given": "args=[], stdin='a!b@c#d', stdout='', stderr=''",
      "expect": "0",
      "polarity": "success",
      "covers": "happy"
    },
    {
      "name": "Large max length",
      "given": "args=['--max', '100'], stdin='Short', stdout='', stderr=''",
      "expect": "0",
      "polarity": "success",
      "covers": "boundary"
    }
  ]
}
```

```go
package cli_test

import (
	"bytes"
	"io"
	"strings"
	"testing"

	"example.com/slugify/cli"
)

func TestRun(t *testing.T) {
	tests := []struct {
		name      string
		args      []string
		stdinStr  string
		wantExit  int
		wantOut   string
		wantErr   string
	}{
		{
			name:     "Happy path with input and max length",
			args:     []string{"--max", "5"},
			stdinStr: "Hello World!",
			wantExit: 0,
			wantOut:  "hello-world-",
		},
		{
			name:     "Empty input",
			args:     []string{},
			stdinStr: "",
			wantExit: 0,
			wantOut:  "",
		},
		{
			name:     "Max length zero or less (no limit)",
			args:     []string{"--max", "0"},
			stdinStr: "Test String",
			wantExit: 0,
			wantOut:  "test-string",
		},
		{
			name:     "Non-alphanumeric characters",
			args:     []string{},
			stdinStr: "a!b@c#d",
			wantExit: 0,
			wantOut:  "a-b-c-d",
		},
		{
			name:     "Large max length",
			args:     []string{"--max", "100"},
			stdinStr: "Short",
			wantExit: 0,
			wantOut:  "short",
		},
	}

	for _, tt := range tests {
		t.Run(tt.name, func(t *testing.T) {
			stdin := strings.NewReader(tt.stdinStr)
			stdout := &bytes.Buffer{}
			stderr := &bytes.Buffer{}

			gotExit := cli.Run(tt.args, stdin, stdout, stderr)

			if gotExit != tt.wantExit {
				t.Errorf("Run() exit = %v, want %v", gotExit, tt.wantExit)
			}
			if tt.wantOut != "" && !strings.Contains(stdout.String(), tt.wantOut) {
				t.Errorf("Run() stdout = %q, want to contain %q", stdout.String(), tt.wantOut)
			}
			if tt.wantErr != "" && !strings.Contains(stderr.String(), tt.wantErr) {
				t.Errorf("Run() stderr = %q, want to contain %q", stderr.String(), tt.wantErr)
			}
		})
	}
}

// ErrorWriter is a test double used to provoke errors in the writer.
type ErrorWriter struct{}

func (e ErrorWriter) Write(p []byte) (n int, err error) {
	return 0, io.ErrClosedPipe
}
```
